== Usage ==
The license value inserted automatically when a contributor picks '''"Elite Dangerous in-game screenshot"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Wraps the shared {{tl|Frontier assets notice}} wording and adds [[:Category:Elite Dangerous screenshots]]. For a screenshot that also needs the fuller metadata fields (description, subject, capture date, etc.), use {{tl|Elite Dangerous screenshot}} on the file page instead — it includes this same notice.
